LBY.note: Document states no digital-skills training for civil servants.
Only a hub's future entrepreneurship training including digital skills; not a national public digital-skills programme.
Document states nothing about local government office connection.
No startup law, strategy, labelling or fund stated.

facts.fact: UNDP states the Tripoli Business Hub, Libya's first municipality-led business hub, officially opened on 10 August 2025 with EU and Italian support, and will offer co-working, mentorship and training for start-ups.
